title: How To make easy Kimchi at home – Korean Kimchi Recipe
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Chawal ka attta (Rice flour) 1 & ½ tbs
Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) ½ Cup or to taste
Namak (Salt) 1 & ½ tsp or to taste
Hara pyaz (Spring onion) chopped ½ Cup

steps.instruction: In a saucepan,add water,rice flour & whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: Saucepan mein pani aur chawal ka atta dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: Turn on the flame & cook on low flame until it thickens.
steps.romanUrdu: Chulha on karein aur halki ancch per garha ho janay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add brown sugar,mix well & cook for 1-2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Brown sugar dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 1-2 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: In a chopper,add onion,garlic,ginger & chop well.
steps.romanUrdu: Chopper mein pyaz,lehsan aur adrak dal ker ache tarhan chop ker lein.

steps.instruction: Take out in a bowl,add cooked rice flour mixture,red chilli powder,salt,paprika powder,fish sauce,mix until well combined & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein nikal lein,cooked rice flour mixture,lal mirch powder,namak,paprika powder & fish sauce dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Cut napa cabbage lengthwise through the stem into quarters.Cut the stem from each piece then cut each quarter into wide pieces.
steps.romanUrdu: Napa cabbage ko lengthwise cut ker lein phir quarters mein cut ker ka wide pieces mein cut ker lein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add napa cabbage,water,salt,mix well & let it brine for 3-4 hours (flip sides in between).
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein napa cabbage,pani aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein aur 2-3 hours brinr hunay kliya chor dein aur bech nech mein sides ko flip kertay rahein.

steps.instruction: Rinse cabbage with tap water few times to get rid of salt & let it drain for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Cabbage ko tap water sa few dafa rinse ker ka 30 minutes kliya drain ker lein.

steps.instruction: In a large bowl,add cabbage,chives carrots,radish,spring onion,prepared spice mixture & mix until well combined.It will have a pungent smell which is normal.
steps.romanUrdu: Large bowl mein cabbage,chives,gajar,mooli,hara pyaz aur tayyar spice mixture dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Transfer the kimchi in an airtight container & let it ferment at room temperature for 24 hours.
steps.romanUrdu: Kimchi ko airtight container mein transfer ker lein aur room temperature per 24 hours ferment hunay kliya chor dein.

steps.instruction: You may see bubbles inside the container & brine may seep out of the lid.
steps.romanUrdu: Container ka ander bubble nazar ayengay.

steps.instruction: Check the kimchi once a day, opening the container & pressing down on the vegetables with a clean spoon to keep them submerged under the brine & refrigerator for 3-4 days & stir in between few times. Kimchi is ready!
steps.romanUrdu: Aglay din kimchi ko khol ein aur clean spoon ki madad sa vegetables ko press down ker lein ta ka brine ka ander vegetables submerged ho jayein aur 3-4 din kliya refrigerator ker lein.Kimchi tayyar hai.

steps.instruction: Kimchi can be stored in an airtight container in a refrigerator for up to 2 months.
steps.romanUrdu: Kimchi ko 2 months kliya airtight container mein dal ker refrigerate ker saktay han.

steps.instruction: Always use clean spoon each time to extract the kimchi from the container or jar.
steps.romanUrdu: Kimchi ko container sa nikalnay kliya hamasha saaf spoon use karein.
